correctness.rationale: Every coordinate is essential for one of the two inputs, giving exact zero/one caps; sharing both symbols contradicts the opposite orders, and simultaneous cap equality violates essentiality. The remaining full-zero or full-one case forces a unique central run and two boundary-constrained outside words. Every construction is deletion-minimal, and binomial-squared counting is exact. A separately structured brute-force single-deletion checker agrees with all 16 small parameter pairs, plus four interleaving-based larger asymmetric checks; infinite proof is symbolic.
